serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Replit for Government is a cloud platform that lets government organizations securely build, run and deploy software with the help of AI. It combines an AI agent that plans, builds, tests and changes applications from natural-language prompts, with a Cloud Development Environment that gives each user an isolated cloud workspace with a persistent filesystem, in-browser and SSH access, real-time collaboration and AI coding assistance. Through Replit Deployments, users can deploy applications that are immediately shareable with your teams on a secure platform for mission critical federal systems.

trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Agencies can request access through the Replit for Government trust center. Replit’s GRC team reviews each request and grants access to the FedRAMP certification data in the trust center.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: AI agent that plans, builds, tests and changes applications from natural-language prompts inside the user's cloud workspace.
Isolated cloud workspaces with a persistent filesystem for writing, running and testing code, with in-browser and SSH access, real-time collaboration and AI coding assistance.
Hosting for applications built on Replit, offered as Reserved VM, Autoscale and Static deployments, each with a build and deployment step.
